Houston Website Maintenance

Website Maintenance & Repair Services in Houston, TX

Your website is often the first thing a customer judges you on, so it needs to stay fast, secure, and working every single day. Fix Website Issues keeps Houston business websites updated and protected, fixes errors, hacks, and downtime the moment they happen, and safeguards your visibility in Google and AI-powered search. In short: we maintain it, we repair it when it breaks, and we keep it ranking. WevTEC, headquartered in Downtown Houston, provides professional website maintenance, repair, and technical support for businesses throughout Houston and across the country. Since 2013, we have helped small businesses, contractors, medical practices, law firms, cleaning companies, remodelers, auto businesses, and other service-based companies keep their websites dependable, secure, and performing the way they should.

Houston-Based Since 2013 | Plans From $300/Month | 24/7 Emergency Repair | Same-Day Fixes for Most Errors

Get a Maintenance Quote
Call (832) 266-7209
The monthly maintenance cycle
1. UpdateCore, plugins, themes, PHP, tested before and after
2. SecureMalware scans, firewall, logins, SSL, file integrity
3. SpeedCore Web Vitals, caching, images, database cleanup
4. Back upOff-site copies with a tested restore
5. MonitorUptime, errors, forms, Search Console, rankings
Any time: Repair24/7 emergency response for hacks, outages, and errors

Houston-Based Website Maintenance With Nationwide Support

 

Through Fix Website Issues, the website repair and technical SEO division of WevTEC, we maintain WordPress, WooCommerce, and custom websites with monthly plans starting at $300, plus 24/7 emergency website repair support when urgent issues arise. We serve businesses across Katy, Sugar Land, Pearland, The Woodlands, Greater Houston, and nationwide. Our goal is simple: keep your website protected, running smoothly, and ready to support your business every day. Every maintenance plan follows the same technical standards as our nationwide website maintenance services, backed by a responsive Houston-based team you can call when you need help.

 

Future-Proofing Your Website for the AI Era with WevTEC

WevTEC is fully equipped with the specialized technical expertise and forward-thinking marketing strategies required to future-proof your business website for today’s rapidly evolving AI-driven digital landscape. As website marketing transitions away from traditional keyword stuffing and manual ad optimization toward Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), autonomous campaign adaptation, and hyper-personalized user journeys, WevTEC bridges the gap by building advanced, resilient web infrastructure. We integrate semantic search optimization, first-party data privacy frameworks, and dynamic user experiences tailored to meet modern search engine and LLM citation standards. By partnering with WevTEC, your business website moves beyond a static digital brochure to become an autonomous, high-performing ecosystem designed to capture high-intent leads and dominate your market in the new era of artificial intelligence.

Plans

From $300/Month

Basic, Advanced, and Premium plans; no long-term contract required.

Response

24/7 Emergency, Same-Day Fixes

Hacks, outages, white screens, and broken checkouts handled around the clock.

Platforms

WordPress, WooCommerce, Custom

Plus Shopify storefronts and PHP or CMS sites built by other agencies.

Visibility

SEO and AI Search Included

Technical SEO checks in every plan; Google Business Profile and AI visibility in Advanced and up.

What Is Website Maintenance?

Website maintenance is the scheduled, ongoing work of keeping a website’s software current, its security intact, its pages fast and error-free, its data backed up, and its visibility in Google and AI search protected. For a Houston business that is a monthly cycle of updates, security scans, speed checks, backups, and monitoring, plus fast repair when something breaks between cycles. Hosting keeps a site online; maintenance keeps it working, safe, and found.

Most website failures we repair in Houston were preventable: a plugin left un-updated for a year until a known vulnerability was exploited; a PHP version the host retired, taking the site down; a contact form that silently stopped sending leads for months; a checkout that broke after a theme update nobody tested. Maintenance exists so those things are caught on a schedule instead of discovered by a customer.

Why it matters more now

Google’s guidance for both classic Search and its AI features rewards sites that are crawlable, fast, secure, and current. AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity retrieve live pages to answer questions; a site that is slow, blocked, or full of errors is skipped. Maintenance is the layer that keeps a business eligible to be found at all, which is why every one of our plans includes technical SEO checks and why the Advanced and Premium plans add Google Business Profile and AI search optimization for Houston.

Every Houston plan includes

  • CMS, plugin, theme, and PHP updates, tested
  • Security monitoring and malware prevention
  • Scheduled off-site backups with restore
  • Uptime, error, and form monitoring
  • Speed and Core Web Vitals checks
  • Technical SEO health checks
  • A Houston phone number that gets answered

Who Website Maintenance in Houston Is For

Any business whose website brings in calls, bookings, quotes, or orders. In practice the Houston businesses that get the most from a maintenance plan fall into a few groups.

Small and family-owned businesses without an in-house IT person. The owner is the webmaster by default, updates get skipped, and the first sign of trouble is a customer saying the site is down.

Service companies that live on lead forms: cleaning, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, pest control. A form that fails for a week in Katy or Cypress is a week of lost jobs, and nobody notices until the phone goes quiet.

Automotive shops, dealers, and detailers with booking widgets, inventory feeds, and Google Business Profiles that need to agree with the website.

Construction and trade contractors whose sites carry project galleries, license and insurance details, and bid-request forms that must stay accurate for commercial clients.

Clinics, dental and legal practices, and ecommerce stores where downtime, data exposure, or a broken checkout has compliance and revenue consequences. Our hacked website repair team handles the emergencies; maintenance keeps them from happening.

Signs your website needs maintenance now

  • Sudden drop in Google traffic, calls, or form submissions
  • Pages load slowly or throw server errors
  • Browser shows a security warning or “not secure”
  • Google Search Console emails about errors or a manual action
  • WordPress shows a stack of pending updates
  • Hosting suspended the account or flagged malware
  • The site looks different on your phone than it did last month

When something else comes first

If the site is hacked, redirecting visitors, or completely down, start with hacked website repair or WordPress error repair; maintenance begins once the site is stable. If the site is fine but invisible in AI answers, see Houston GEO services.

Problems Website Maintenance Solves for Houston Businesses

These are the six failures we repair most often for Houston clients who did not have a maintenance plan. Each one is caught on the monthly cycle once they do.

Problem

The site gets hacked

Outdated plugins are the usual entry point; the result is spam pages, redirects, and a Google warning. Fix: monthly updates, malware scanning, firewall rules, login hardening, and a clean backup to restore from.

Problem

Lead forms stop sending

An email deliverability change or plugin update breaks the contact form and nobody notices for weeks. Fix: monthly form tests, SMTP with logging, and alerts when a submission fails.

Problem

An update breaks the layout or checkout

A theme or WooCommerce update changes something and the homepage or cart falls apart. Fix: updates run on a staging copy first, a visual check before and after, and instant rollback if needed.

Problem

The site is slow and rankings slide

Unoptimized images, bloated plugins, and no caching push load times past what Google and visitors tolerate. Fix: caching, image compression, database cleanup, and Core Web Vitals tracked monthly.

Problem

No usable backup when it matters

The host’s backup is missing, corrupted, or overwritten by the hacked version. Fix: off-site backups on a schedule, kept for weeks, with a restore actually tested.

Problem

Google and AI search quietly lose the site

Redirect chains, a stray noindex, an expired SSL, or a blocked crawler drop pages from Google, AI Overviews, and ChatGPT answers. Fix: Search Console review, crawler access checks, and schema and Business Profile kept consistent every month.

Website Problems We Repair for Houston Businesses

Maintenance prevents most of these — but when a Houston website is already broken, we also repair it as a one-time job, then optionally keep it stable with a plan. These are the failures businesses bring us most often. Need it fixed now? Get website repair help.

Repair

WordPress Errors

Plugin conflicts, failed updates, the white screen of death, and “critical error” or locked-out dashboards.

WordPress error repair

Repair

Hacked or Infected Websites

Malware, injected spam, redirects to casino or pharma pages, rogue admin accounts, and “this site may be hacked” warnings.

Hacked website repair

Repair

Website Down or Server Errors

500 and 502 errors, “error establishing a database connection,” DNS and SSL failures, and hosting outages.

Server, cPanel & database repair

Repair

Broken Forms & Features

Contact forms not sending, broken booking or checkout, dead buttons, and integrations that quietly stopped working.

Repair

Website Speed Problems

Slow pages, failing Core Web Vitals, heavy scripts, bloated databases, and poor performance on phones.

Speed optimization

Repair

Broken Mobile Layouts

Overlapping text, cut-off sections, distorted images, and menus that break once the site is opened on a phone.

Repair

SEO Technical Problems

Indexing and canonical errors, broken redirects, 404s, orphaned pages, and XML sitemap or schema issues.

Technical SEO repair

Repair

Website Migration Problems

Missing pages, broken links, mixed-content warnings, and lost rankings after a host move, redesign, or domain change.

Website migration support

Houston Website Maintenance Plans and Monthly Pricing

Three plans, month to month, priced by what your site needs rather than by page count. Every plan includes the maintenance cycle above; higher plans add visibility and marketing work.

Basic

Basic Website Maintenance

$300 / month

For small businesses that need a stable, secure, updated site.

  • Scheduled off-site backups
  • CMS, plugin, theme, and PHP updates
  • Security monitoring and malware prevention
  • Error and uptime monitoring, minor fixes
  • Monthly form and speed checks
  • Technical SEO health check

Start Basic

Advanced · Most Popular

Advanced Maintenance + Visibility

$500–$1,000 / month

For growing Houston businesses that want the site maintained and found.

  • Everything in Basic
  • Google Business Profile maintenance and updates
  • On-page and technical SEO fixes each month
  • Local SEO for Houston and your service areas
  • AI search readiness: crawler access, schema, entity consistency
  • One social media channel supported
  • Monthly performance and security report
Start Advanced
Premium

Premium Maintenance + Digital Marketing

$1,500–$2,000 / month

For businesses that want the website fully managed and actively growing.

  • Everything in Advanced
  • Ongoing SEO strategy and content support
  • Google Ads or paid campaign management
  • Social media management
  • Conversion tracking and call/form attribution
  • AI visibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot
  • Quarterly strategy review
Start Premium

Pricing scales with site complexity (ecommerce, multi-location, custom code). Emergency repair for non-plan clients is quoted per job. No setup fee for Houston businesses that start on a plan.

Website Maintenance by Industry in Houston

Every industry breaks in its own way. These are the maintenance priorities we set for the Houston business types we work with most, and what a month of care looks like for each.

Industry

Small Business Website Maintenance

Restaurants, salons, boutiques, fitness studios, accountants, insurance agents, and the thousands of Houston businesses running a 5-to-15-page WordPress site nobody has touched since it launched.

Monthly priorities: updates and backups, a working contact form and click-to-call, hours and address matching Google Business Profile, SSL renewal, and a speed check so the site loads on a phone in a parking lot. Basic plan is usually the right fit.

Industry

Cleaning Company Website Maintenance

Residential, commercial janitorial, carpet, pressure washing, and post-construction cleaning companies across Houston, Katy, Cypress, and Pearland compete almost entirely on “cleaning service near me” searches and instant quote forms.

Monthly priorities: quote and booking forms tested with a real submission, service-area pages kept current, Google Business Profile categories and photos maintained, review schema accurate, and fast mobile pages, since most cleaning leads arrive from a phone. Advanced plan adds the local SEO that keeps you in the map pack.

Industry

Remodeling Contractor Website Maintenance

Kitchen and bath remodelers, room additions, flooring, and design-build firms in Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Bellaire, and Memorial sell on their portfolio. Heavy image galleries are exactly what slows a site down and what breaks when a gallery plugin is abandoned.

Monthly priorities: image compression and lazy loading, gallery and slider plugin health, project pages with accurate before-and-after content, license and insurance details current, estimate forms tested, and Core Web Vitals kept green so the portfolio loads before the visitor leaves.

Industry

Automotive Website Maintenance

Repair shops, body shops, tire centers, detailers, and independent dealers along I-45, 290, and the Southwest Freeway rely on online booking, inventory feeds, and Google Business Profile hours that change with the season.

Monthly priorities: booking widget and inventory feed integrations tested, service pages for the makes you specialize in kept indexable, hours and holiday closures synced, review and LocalBusiness schema accurate, and a check that the site still loads with third-party scripts from CARFAX, DealerSocket, or a scheduling vendor.

Industry

Construction Company Website Maintenance

General contractors, roofing, concrete, foundation repair, commercial builders, and trade subcontractors from Conroe to Rosenberg use the website to prove credibility to commercial clients and to capture bid requests.

Monthly priorities: project galleries and case pages current, certifications and safety records accurate, bid and RFP forms with file upload tested, careers pages working, PDF downloads still linked, and security hardening, because contractor sites are frequent targets for spam injection that quietly ruins Google rankings.

Industry

Healthcare, Legal, Ecommerce, and More

Clinics, urgent care, dental and medical practices, law firms, ecommerce stores, real estate, restaurants, and corporate sites have been part of our Houston client base since 2013.

Monthly priorities: patient and client forms handled with care for privacy, appointment and case-intake integrations tested, WooCommerce and payment gateways verified with a test order, provider and attorney pages accurate, and structured data for doctors and services maintained; see our guide to schema SEO for doctors.

Website Maintenance Across Greater Houston

Our office is in Houston and all work is done remotely with secure, controlled access, so response time is the same whether you are in Midtown or Montgomery County. These are the ten areas where most of our maintenance clients are based.

Website Maintenance in Central Houston: Downtown, Midtown, Montrose, Heights, Galleria

Law firms, medical practices, agencies, restaurants, and corporate offices inside the Loop run on multi-user WordPress and custom sites with more integrations than most. Maintenance here is heavy on staging-first updates, user and access audits, and uptime monitoring, and we are minutes away when an on-site conversation helps.

Website Maintenance in Katy and Fulshear

Katy’s growth along I-10 and the Grand Parkway means a crowded field of remodelers, cleaning companies, pediatric and dental practices, and home service businesses all chasing the same map pack. For Katy clients we keep service-area pages, Google Business Profile, and LocalBusiness schema in agreement so a maintained site does not lose ground to a newer competitor with cleaner data.

Website Maintenance in Sugar Land and Missouri City

Sugar Land’s professional-services base, including CPAs, financial advisors, specialty clinics, and design-build remodelers near Town Square and First Colony, tends to run polished sites that were built once and then left alone. Our work here is often bringing an older, well-designed site up to current PHP, security, and Core Web Vitals standards without changing how it looks.

Website Maintenance in Cypress and Northwest Houston

Along 290 and 99 the client mix is contractors, wholesale distributors, auto repair, and fast-growing residential service companies with a truck fleet and a lead form. Cypress sites frequently carry quoting tools and scheduling integrations, so monthly form and integration tests are the item that pays for the plan.

Website Maintenance in The Woodlands and Spring

Corporate headquarters, energy-sector service firms, medical groups, and upscale remodelers around The Woodlands and Spring expect enterprise-level reliability: staging environments, documented change logs, and a monthly report someone can forward to a partner or board. We provide all three on the Advanced and Premium plans.

Website Maintenance in Pearland and Friendswood

Pearland’s mix of family-owned retail, dental and pediatric practices, cleaning companies, and construction trades serving the south side and Brazoria County means a lot of small sites where the owner is the only admin. We take the updates, backups, and security off their plate and keep the Google Business Profile matching the site.

Website Maintenance in Conroe and Montgomery County

Conroe’s construction companies, RV and auto dealers, lake-area hospitality, and industrial suppliers north on I-45 often run sites built by a previous vendor who has moved on. We take over sites we did not build, document what is there, and stabilize them before adding anything.

Website Maintenance in Tomball and Magnolia

Trade contractors, equipment dealers, veterinary and family practices, and Old Town Tomball shops rely on straightforward sites that need to stay up, stay fast, and keep the phone number and hours right. Basic plan clients here get the same monthly cycle and the same emergency line as everyone else.

Website Maintenance in Richmond and Rosenberg

Fort Bend County’s fastest-growing corridor is home to new construction, home services, auto repair, and agricultural and industrial suppliers. Our team members live and work in this area, which is why Richmond and Rosenberg businesses can get a same-day in-person meeting when a project calls for one.

Website Maintenance in Pasadena, Baytown, and the East Side

Industrial contractors, petrochemical service companies, trucking, and the auto and body shops along 225 and I-10 East need sites that pass a procurement team’s scrutiny: working RFQ forms, current certifications, and no security warnings. Maintenance here leans on security hardening and document management.

Also serving Bellaire, West University, Memorial, Aldine, Humble, Kingwood, League City, Clear Lake, Stafford, and every other Greater Houston community. Outside Texas? See our Dallas and Miami pages or our nationwide website maintenance service.

The Monthly Website Maintenance Checklist We Run

Every Houston maintenance client gets this ten-point cycle each month, logged and reported. Items 1 through 6 are in every plan; 7 through 10 are where the Advanced and Premium plans go deeper.

Get a Free Site Health Check
  1. Backup and verify. Full off-site backup before any change; a restore tested at least quarterly.
  2. Update and test. Core, plugins, themes, and PHP updated on staging, then live, with a visual and functional check.
  3. Security sweep. Malware scan, file integrity, firewall rules, admin accounts, SSL expiry, login attempts.
  4. Uptime and error review. Monitor logs, 404s, PHP errors, and server warnings from the past month.
  5. Forms and conversions. Every lead form, booking widget, and click-to-call tested with a real submission.
  6. Speed and Core Web Vitals. Field data reviewed; images, caching, and scripts tuned as needed.
  7. Search Console review. Index coverage, crawl errors, manual actions, and performance trends for Houston queries.
  8. Google Business Profile sync. Hours, categories, services, photos, and posts kept consistent with the site.
  9. Schema and entity check. LocalBusiness, Service, and FAQ markup validated and matched to visible content; AI crawler access confirmed.
  10. Report and recommend. A plain-English monthly summary of what was done, what was found, and what to do next.

How Website Maintenance Works With Fix Website Issues

Step 1 — Free site health check

A call or form, then we look at the site: errors, security state, speed, index coverage, and whether the forms work. You get findings before you pay anything.

Step 2 — Stabilize first

If the check turns up a hack, a broken update, or a hosting problem, that is repaired first as a one-time job. Maintenance starts on a stable site.

Step 3 — Onboard and document

Secure access is set up, a full backup taken, and the site documented: plugins, integrations, hosting, DNS, who has admin rights. Sites built by other vendors are welcome.

Step 4 — Run the monthly cycle

The ten-point checklist above, every month, with staging-first updates and a written log.

Step 5 — Handle emergencies

Plan clients call the same Houston number 24/7. Most errors are fixed the same day; hacks are contained within hours.

Step 6 — Report and improve

A monthly summary in plain English, plus the SEO, Business Profile, and AI visibility work that Advanced and Premium plans include.

How We Approach Maintenance

We are a repair company first. Since 2013 most of our Houston clients have found us after something broke. That shapes how we maintain: we know which plugins fail, which hosts retire PHP versions without warning, and which “minor” updates take down a WooCommerce checkout. Prevention is built from that repair history.

Updates are tested, not clicked. Bulk-updating everything on a live site is how layouts break. We update on a staging copy, check the pages that matter, then push live, and keep the backup ready.

Forms are checked with real submissions. A green checkmark in a plugin dashboard means nothing if the email never arrives. We submit the form and confirm the lead lands in your inbox or CRM.

Visibility is part of maintenance. A site that works but has quietly fallen out of Google, AI Overviews, or ChatGPT answers is not being maintained. Search Console, Business Profile, schema, and crawler access are on the checklist, and our AI search optimization team handles the deeper work when a client wants it.

Maintenance vs Hosting vs One-Time Repair

Houston business owners often assume hosting covers maintenance. It does not. This is what each one actually does.

AreaWeb hostingOne-time repairMonthly maintenance
What it doesKeeps the server onlineFixes a specific problem after it happensPrevents problems and keeps the site current, secure, fast, and visible
UpdatesServer software onlyWhatever is needed for the fixCMS, plugins, themes, PHP, tested monthly
SecurityNetwork level; the site itself is your responsibilityCleanup after a hackScans, firewall, hardening, and monitoring before a hack
BackupsOften present, rarely tested, sometimes overwrittenUses whatever existsScheduled, off-site, retained, restore-tested
SEO and AI visibilityNoneOnly if the problem was SEO-relatedSearch Console, Business Profile, schema, and crawler checks monthly
Typical cost$10 to $100+ per monthQuoted per job; hacks are the expensive ones$300 to $2,000 per month depending on plan

What Maintenance Cannot Guarantee

  • No plan makes a site un-hackable; maintenance sharply reduces the risk and guarantees a clean, recent backup to restore from.
  • We cannot control hosting outages, domain expirations you manage elsewhere, or third-party services (payment gateways, booking vendors) going down.
  • Rankings, AI citations, traffic, and leads depend on many factors beyond site health. Maintenance protects eligibility; it does not promise positions.
  • Sites with abandoned, incompatible, or nulled plugins may need a rebuild of those parts before they can be maintained safely; we say so up front.
  • Same-day repair is typical, not guaranteed; complex hacks and host-side problems can take longer, and we tell you when they will.
Example methodology, not a case study

How a Typical First Month Goes for a Katy Remodeling Contractor

Situation. A kitchen-and-bath remodeler in Katy with a five-year-old WordPress site, a 300-image portfolio, and an estimate form. The owner suspects leads have dropped but does not know why.

Health check finds. 23 pending plugin updates including a gallery plugin no longer maintained; PHP 7.4 on a host that is about to retire it; the estimate form sending to an email address that no longer exists; portfolio pages taking 9 seconds on mobile; Google Business Profile listing the old shop address.

Week 1. Full backup, fix the form recipient and add logging, correct the Business Profile address, update PHP on staging and confirm nothing breaks.

Weeks 2 to 3. Replace the abandoned gallery plugin, compress and lazy-load the portfolio, apply the remaining updates on staging, then live. Add LocalBusiness schema matching the site and Profile.

Week 4. First monthly report: form now delivering, mobile load under 3 seconds, Search Console clean, and a list of next steps. Then the cycle repeats. Outcomes vary by site; this describes the structure of the work, not a promised result.

Is Your Houston Website Secure, Fast, and Actually Sending You Leads?

We will check the errors, security, speed, forms, and Google visibility for free and tell you what we find, whether or not you start a plan.

Request My Free Health Check
Call (832) 266-7209

Why Houston Businesses Choose Fix Website Issues for Maintenance

Fix Website Issues is the website repair and technical SEO division of WevTEC, based in Houston and serving businesses across Greater Houston and nationwide since 2013. Maintenance is done by the same team that repairs hacked, broken, and de-indexed sites every week, which is why our checklist covers the things that actually fail.

  • A Houston team that answers the phone, with in-person meetings available across the metro when a project calls for one.
  • Repair expertise built into prevention: staging-first updates, tested backups, real form submissions.
